SkillBridge Fellowship Training Plan

This training plan covers the SkillBridge fellowship of Marcus T. Delgado with Ironvale Energy Services, from June 2, 2025 to August 22, 2025. The fellowship takes place at the host's Odessa field office.

Instructor Qualification: Mentorship and instruction will be provided by Dana Whitfield, Director of Field Operations at Ironvale Energy Services. Dana has 14 years of experience leading wind-site maintenance teams.

Job Title: Wind Turbine Technician Fellow

Job Description: The fellow will train alongside Ironvale's field maintenance crews, learning scheduled preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and safety procedures for utility-scale wind turbines.

Responsibilities:
- Assist crews with scheduled preventive maintenance on turbine drivetrains
- Document inspection findings in the maintenance tracking system
- Support lockout/tagout procedures under direct supervision
- Participate in daily safety briefings and toolbox talks

Skills to be Developed:
- Technical Insight & Analysis
- Equipment Maintenance
- Safety & Compliance Procedures
- Team Communication

Weekly Hours: The fellow is expected on site approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Weeks 1-2 focus on orientation and safety certification; weeks 3-12 rotate through maintenance crews.
